name: cmux.newtab.widget/1
docs: A widget on the New Tab page: a small scene cmux draws in the page's widget row, beside its own widgets (clock, timer, quote), with the page's tokens. The render export gets the mount context ({surface: "newTab"}) and returns the widget's view. It mounts only on an open New Tab page where the person placed the widget (Edit New Tab > Add Widgets). A switch to another tab and back keeps the mount: the page draws the same widget and asks nothing again. It unmounts when the page closes, and a timer it starts belongs to the mount and stops then (cmux.timer.every is floored at 1 s). The page can be hidden while the widget is mounted, and cmux may pause a hidden page's timers, so do not rely on a tick while nobody looks. Nodes outside `nodes` are refused, and a scene over `maxNodes` stops drawing: the cell shows the widget's name and why, never a broken page. Clicks run the node's onTap with the app's own scopes.

size.description: The widget's cell: small sits inline in the row (a clock), wide takes the row's whole width (a list). Default small.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
